version: Home Auth Register Country Phone G2-r32

proposed_behavior.initial_country: Propose Thailand +66 as fixed initial UI choice, not location inference; not approved by the coverage decision alone.
proposed_behavior.control: Dial-code trigger108x44 with existing22px circular flag and chevron; phone-number input alongside inside existing phone field.
proposed_behavior.picker: Open anchored country list with search by country/name/code and current-country check; TH +66 and GB +44 are illustrative rows, not an exhaustive or approved production country inventory.
proposed_behavior.selection: Selecting a country updates its flag/code and closes the picker, returning to the phone field. This does not define normalization/number validity or silently clear/replace an entered number.
proposed_behavior.dismissal: Click within Auth outside the country list dismisses only the list; click Home dimmed area outside Auth dismisses Auth under the accepted rule. Nested Escape handling remains a keyboard contract to verify, not a runtime claim.
proposed_behavior.form_reset: When Auth is dismissed, clear entered phone/other form drafts per accepted clear-all rule; on reopen use the proposed initial country if subsequently accepted.
proposed_behavior.Login: Shared email/phone Login entry remains unchanged in this revision; its international-phone presentation still needs alignment without a country selector on an email value.
proposed_behavior.other_fields: Retain English/digit Username3–20, email/password/confirmation and Google path; no SMS, verification or phone recovery added.
